uart.signal: committed ELF fixture (tests/fixtures/esp32c6-demo.elf) booted in-sim; assert_uart_contains matches 'OK\\n' on a real bus.attach_uart_tx_sink capture after the firmware ungates UART0 through the C6's PCR and routes GPIO16/U0TXD via IO_MUX. Fixture absence is a hard assert!, not a skip. Independently corroborated by the bus_visibility edge gate: esp32c6 shows UART decodable-edge visibility on the wire channel.
uart.lane: core-ci / pr-workspace-tests: cargo test -p labwired-core --test firmware_survival

spi.gap: no SPI window is declared on configs/chips/esp32c6.yaml, so there is nothing to drive; the SPI0/1/2 windows are deliberately unmapped at L1.

i2c.gap: no I2C window is declared on configs/chips/esp32c6.yaml; the I2C0 window is deliberately unmapped at L1. The C3's I2C-matrix signal indices do not transfer (I2CEXT0_SCL is 45 on the C6 vs 53 on the C3).
